newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt, Nellcor deal wins approval.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt, Nellcor deal wins approval.

text.p: Mallinckrodt Inc said Friday the period for Hart-Scott-Rodino regulatory review of its intended acquisition of Nellcor Puritan Bennett Inc has expired with no further request for additional information.
Required international regulatory reviews are proceeding, the company said in a news release.

On July 23, Mallinckrodt agreed to purchase for cash all of the shares of Nellcor Puritan Bennett for $28.50 a share. A tender offer began July 29 and is scheduled to expire on August 25, unless extended.
Mallinckrodt produces diagnostic imaging agents, medical devices and pharmaceuticals.
Nellcor Puritan Bennett provides products for monitoring, diagnosing and treating respiratory conditions.
